decisions.reason: The fouling detection automation was not shown on the website in 2024 and its sister fouling system was already withdrawn, which weakens the signal about its value, but it builds on the existing automation offer and costs little to keep while its energy-recovery value is still uncertain.
The spring-controlled flap weir, launched in 2024 and close to the core weir business, is still too new for its demand to be known, and keeping it on the market costs little.

The energy management system fits the firm's strategic move toward digital networking and energy efficiency, so this option has high potential upside and is worth keeping open while municipal uptake becomes clear.
The overflow flap gate line has several models and its own web page, which shows commitment to it, and it sits close to the established hydraulic steelwork business, so keeping it costs little.
